questions.question: Trident Manufacturing Ltd. is a mid -sized company that has traditionally focused only on hiring skilled workers and providing basic on -the-job training when machines are upgraded. Recently, the HR Manager, Priya, noticed that employees feel demotivated, promotions are unclear and the company struggles to prepare people for leadership roles. She proposes shifting the HR department’s focus from simply “managing manpower” to actively developing employees through structured training, career planning, mentoring, and performance -linked development programs essentially building a formal Human Resource Development (HRD) system. Question: Based on the scenario above, explain the concept of Human Resource Development (HRD) and describe how the underlying principles and mechanisms (such as training and development, performance appraisal, career planning, and organizational development) would help Priya address the problems at Trident Manufacturing Ltd.
